conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: I’m thrilled! My loan pre-closure was approved. Just need to know the final steps.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: That’s wonderful news Sir! Can you confirm your loan account number to finalize the process?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: It’s three two one, six five four, nine eight, seven one. What do I need to do next?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: You’ll need to pay the outstanding balance of ₹50,000. I can generate a payment link for you.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Perfect, send the link. You guys made this so smooth!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Thank you Sir. The link is sent, and once paid, your loan will be closed. I’ll follow up.
